name: lv_obj_get_display

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-10-3.1.28 image: lv_obj_tree.c lv_obj_get_display; logs 'No screen found' and returns 0 for an object that is not attached to any display.

notes: Walks the parent chain to the screen and scans the display list for it. A NULL result proves the object is detached (the display never draws it).
